Experience

Interactive Geoscience Student

Alberta Energy Regulator, Alberta Geological Survey

May to August 2026 · Calgary, hybrid

  • Built a to-scale model of Alberta's subsurface geology in Minecraft so the public can explore the province's critical minerals.
  • Automated model generation in FME, converting 26 elevation grids across 13 formations into the full province with no manual placement.
  • Added rivers and lakes through a second pipeline on the same grid.
  • Programmed a datapack that turns mineral discovery into a progression-based game, and scripted checks to confirm every grid cell had complete layers.
  • Used GitHub Copilot to speed up development, with automated tests verifying AI-assisted code before it went into the model.
  • Wrote a build manual for reproducibility and presented the project to the branch. A summary is slated for publication in The Reservoir (CEGA).
